name: VRP harvest — IV>RV spread calm long (1d)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (the daily-bar variant of the VRP harvest — slower, one decision per day, so fee drag is trivial and the 30d-implied vs realized comparison is on its natural horizon): a wide IV-over-RV gap means the crypto options market is charging a fat variance risk premium; dealers are structurally short gamma to retail that overpays for convexity/hedges (Deribit 2025). We cannot sell options, so we harvest the proxy: implied>>realized forecasts realized UNDERSHOOTS implied, so the coming days are calmer-than-priced -> a spot long held into the calm. Entry: dvol clears a fitted floor (premium present) AND vol_realized sits below a fitted ceiling on a multi-day window (already calm) AND bb_width sits below a fitted ceiling (bands compressed, an independent compression confirmation). The counterparty is the option BUYER overpaying for tail insurance; we sell that fear. Exit: bb_width crosses up through a fitted expansion level (the calm regime is ending) or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1: substitute dvol ALONE — if the level gate alone matches the deflated Sharpe, the spread carries no extra information and this is a dvol-spike re-skin. DISCONFIRMER 2: if an unconditional daily calm-window long (drop the dvol leg) matches it, the VRP adds nothing over plain low-vol dip. HARD CAVEAT: ~148 DVOL points on the daily grid is thin -> paper-only, non-fundable until the series deepens.
catalyst: implied vol above realized with compressed bands — a variance premium into a calm day-scale window
